name: stephwilt
caption:
OUR GOAT? 🎮🏀 Wilt averaged 50.4 a night for us. Steph has 4 rings. Who's our greatest ever?

• Wilt, 1961-62: 50.4 PPG, and the 100-point game
• 1965: we trade Wilt to Philadelphia, he never wins a title with us
• Steph: 4 titles, 2 MVPs (the only unanimous one ever), a Finals MVP
• Steph passed Wilt's 17,783 to become our all-time leading scorer
• Steph this season: 31.3 PPG through his first 8 games

Steph or Wilt? 👇

facts.claim: Wilt Chamberlain played for the Philadelphia/San Francisco Warriors 1959–1965; averaged 50.4 points in 1961–62 (the 1962 season); scored 100 points in a game; traded to the Philadelphia 76ers in 1965; his first NBA title came with the 76ers in 1966–67

Curry (No. 30): 4× NBA champion, 2× MVP (2015, 2016), the only unanimous MVP in league history, 2022 Finals MVP; surpassed Wilt Chamberlain (17,783) to become the franchise's all-time scoring leader (#1)
